policy.see: Up to 20 reviewed in-boundary attractions, ordered by visitor score.
policy.eat: Up to 20 reviewed in-boundary daytime food stops, ordered by visitor score.
policy.trails: Only genuine visitor routes with a score and responsible external route link. OSM paths alone do not qualify.
policy.dogAccess: Every See and Eat place must have an explicit 0-3 dog-access record. Unconfirmed policies remain visible in detail and in the research queue.
policy.practical: No display cap. Include every reviewed in-boundary picnic place, public car park and public toilet, using location-specific names.
